metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: A high school comedy classic that shares the sharp wit and fashion-forward focus of Clueless.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: A bright, feel-good comedy featuring an underestimated female lead, much like Clueless.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A smart, modern teen comedy that modernizes literature similarly to 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: The predecessor to Wake Up Dead Man, offering a brilliant, fun, and comedic mystery ensemble.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: Further explores the colorful, comedic mystery tone established in the Knives Out series.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A high-octane ensemble comedy with a mystery twist, matching the energy of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written and directed by Shane Black, it features the same witty banter and crime-comedy blend as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A fun, space-faring adventure with a heavy emphasis on humor and music, similar to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: An irreverent, comedic take on the superhero genre that shares the bold humor of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A quintessential fun action-adventure with a mix of fantasy and lighthearted humor like Jumanji.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A perfect blend of fantasy, romance, and comedy that matches the whimsical tone of D&D: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A magical, lighthearted fantasy adventure that fans of Fantastic Beasts and Practical Magic will adore.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: A mockumentary from Sacha Baron Cohen featuring the same boundary-pushing comedy found in Brüno.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A high-concept, video-game-themed action comedy that feels very similar to the modern Jumanji films.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: A stylish, high-energy action film that doesn't take itself too seriously, much like Pacific Rim: Uprising.

metas.name: Men in Black
metas.description: A classic sci-fi comedy blend of action and humor that fits your preference for lighthearted blockbusters.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant parody of action movies that combines mystery and slapstick comedy seamlessly.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: A showcase for Jim Carrey's high-energy physical comedy, perfect if you enjoyed Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Dumb and Dumber
metas.description: A staple of absurdist 90s comedy that aligns with the slapstick nature of your watched list.

metas.name: Zoolander
metas.description: An absurdly funny look at the fashion world that shares the eccentric comedy style of Brüno.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A slick, cool, and funny heist movie that matches the smooth crime-comedy vibe of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Enola Holmes
metas.description: A fast-paced, fourth-wall-breaking mystery adventure that is light, fun, and family-friendly.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A jungle-set romantic adventure comedy that captures the same spirit as Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A delightful creature-feature adventure that is surprisingly heartfelt and funny, much like D&D.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A modern, high-energy teen comedy about friendship that matches the vibe of Clueless.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: The ultimate comfort movie; it is incredibly lighthearted, funny, and beautifully crafted.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie that leans heavily into comedy and childhood wonder, similar to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A visually inventive and funny action-comedy that shares the frantic energy of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
metas.description: A hilarious mockumentary that satirizes the music industry with the same sharpness as Brüno.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A whimsical fantasy-comedy that uses magical realism in a light, comforting, and romantic way.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A visually stunning and deeply uplifting French comedy for fans of quirky, stylized storytelling.

metas.name: Beetlejuice
metas.description: A fun, supernatural comedy that matches the 'cozy-spooky' vibe of Practical Magic.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A stylish, fast-paced, and hilarious caper that feels like a live-action cartoon in the best way.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A high-stakes action comedy that is consistently funny and features great ensemble performances.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever and very funny sci-fi rom-com that puts a fresh spin on the time-loop trope.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult classic adventure that blends fantasy, martial arts, and comedy into a fun, high-octane experience.

metas.name: Barb and Star Go to Vista Del Mar
metas.description: An incredibly silly and colorful comedy that fans of absurdist humor like Ace Ventura will enjoy.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A fun, upbeat musical comedy with great characters and a lighthearted teen-movie spirit.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A loving parody of sci-fi tropes that is genuinely funny and full of heart, similar to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A fast-moving, stylistically violent but very funny action flick that matches the wit of The Nice Guys.
